configuration.selection_note: K32 selected only from seed99 validation pilots structure-pilot-k16-v1 and structure-pilot-k32-v1: fixed current-task accuracy was 0.712/0.695/0.721 at K16 versus 0.906/0.939/0.907 at K32; dense was about 0.98. K32 avoids an excessively restrictive fixed baseline. Neither pilot evaluated test. Shared task and stream APIs frozen; phase800,batch128,lr0.2,rewire50,replace2 fixed before three-seed test.

teaching_signal: teacher one-hot minus predicted probability; externally supervised local delta rule
structural_rule: fixed budget: smallest |weight| drops; largest absolute window pre*residual correlation grows

historical_reference.budget: src/core.py grow_edges uses active-trace threshold and random births; prune uses weight and age
historical_reference.homeo: src/core.py structural_homeo changes E-E counts using rate targets and tolerance
historical_reference.new_experiment: Neither historical rule is executed; no rate or age thresholds are introduced

limitations: Engineered signed context-interaction features; no LIF/firing-rate autonomy claim
Teacher residual is external class-wise feedback, not an artificial edge-importance label
Dense is a larger-budget feasibility control, not evidence for rewiring superiority
Dense allocated arrays and candidate statistics; no event-sparse efficiency claim
A-B-A is a finite interference/relearning probe, not lifelong learning
Only the fixed last model is saved; validation curves never select a checkpoint
